senses.definition: something owned, especially land or a building, or a quality something has
senses.example: They bought a property near the station.

senses.definition: in place of someone or something else
senses.example: We stayed home instead of going out.

senses.definition: things made or sold by a business
senses.example: The shop sells goods from local farms.
senses.note: goods 通常用复数；不是 good（好处）的普通复数用法。

senses.definition: to become better or make something better
senses.example: Her English has improved this year.

senses.definition: things or material when you do not name them exactly
senses.example: Please put your stuff away.

senses.definition: to fill something tightly with material or objects
senses.example: She stuffed the bag with clothes.

senses.definition: a small piece of information about a larger subject
senses.example: Please check every detail in the form.

senses.definition: to describe something fully, including its smaller parts
senses.example: The report details the costs of the project.

senses.definition: a way of doing something, especially one that follows a plan
senses.example: This method makes learning easier.

senses.definition: a person who is not named or known
senses.example: Somebody left a bag on the bus.

senses.definition: a regular publication with articles and pictures, or a container that holds bullets in a gun
senses.example: She reads a travel magazine each month.

senses.definition: a building where people pay to stay for a short time
senses.example: We booked a hotel near the beach.

senses.definition: a person who serves in an army
senses.example: The soldiers returned home after the mission.
senses.note: soldier on 是动词短语，意为遇到困难仍坚持。

senses.definition: to send back light or sound, show a fact or quality, or think carefully
senses.example: The results reflect the students' progress.

senses.definition: weighing a lot, large in amount, or serious and difficult
senses.example: This suitcase is too heavy to carry.

senses.definition: relating to sex, sexual activity, or sexual feelings
senses.example: The school offers age-appropriate sexual health education.

senses.definition: a container made of soft material, or the amount it holds
senses.example: She carried her books in a bag.

senses.definition: to put something into a bag or get something you want
senses.example: We bagged the groceries at the checkout.

senses.definition: the feeling or energy of being hot
senses.example: The heat made it hard to sleep.

senses.definition: to make something warm or hot
senses.example: Heat the soup before serving it.

senses.definition: the legal or social relationship between married people, or the act of marrying
senses.example: They have had a happy marriage for years.

senses.definition: difficult to do or deal with, or strong enough to face difficulty
senses.example: It was a tough decision to make.

senses.definition: to make music with your voice
senses.example: She sings in the school choir.
senses.note: 过去式 sang，过去分词 sung。

senses.definition: the reason for doing something, or the use something is meant for
senses.example: What is the purpose of this meeting?

senses.definition: the outer or top part of something
senses.example: The surface of the lake was calm.

senses.definition: to come to the surface or become known
senses.example: New problems surfaced during testing.

senses.definition: to be real or alive
senses.example: These animals still exist in the wild.

senses.definition: a repeated way something happens or a design made of lines and shapes
senses.example: I noticed a pattern in the test results.

senses.definition: to make a design on something or copy a model
senses.example: The cloth was patterned with flowers.
senses.note: 动词义比名词少见。

senses.definition: to understand something clearly, or make a plan or hope happen
senses.example: I realised I had left my keys at home.
senses.note: realise 是英式拼写；美式通常写 realize。

senses.definition: which person, when that person receives an action or follows a preposition
senses.example: To whom should I send this letter?
senses.note: 日常口语常用 who 代替 whom。

senses.definition: the outer covering of a person, animal, or fruit
senses.example: The sun can damage your skin.

senses.definition: to remove the outer covering or scrape the skin from part of your body
senses.example: She skinned her knee when she fell.

senses.zh: 代理人；经纪人；智能体；作用剂
senses.definition: a person acting for someone else, a substance causing change, or an AI system that acts to complete tasks
senses.example: The agent helped them sell the house.

senses.definition: a person who owns something
senses.example: The dog ran back to its owner.

senses.definition: a device with moving parts that does a task
senses.example: This machine washes the dishes.

senses.definition: a substance like air, fuel burned for heating, or, in American English, petrol
senses.example: The stove uses gas for cooking.

senses.definition: to fill a vehicle with petrol or treat something with gas
senses.example: We stopped to gas up the car.
senses.note: 动词义多见美式口语或技术语境。

senses.definition: in front, before a planned time, or in a leading position
senses.example: Go ahead and I'll follow you.

senses.definition: people born around the same time, or the process of producing something
senses.example: This generation uses phones in new ways.

senses.definition: relating to business or intended to make money
senses.example: The area has many commercial buildings.

senses.definition: an advertisement shown on television, radio, or online
senses.example: We saw a funny commercial on TV.

senses.definition: the details of where someone lives or where a website is, or a formal speech
senses.example: Please write your address on the form.

senses.definition: to deal with a problem, speak to a group, or write an address on something
senses.example: The team will address the issue tomorrow.
senses.note: 名词重音常在前音节；动词重音常在后音节。

senses.definition: a serious disease in which cells in the body grow in an uncontrolled way
senses.example: Early treatment can help some people with cancer.

senses.definition: one thing in a group, list, or set
senses.example: The first item on the list is milk.

senses.definition: what is true or really exists, rather than what is imagined
senses.example: The reality was different from what we expected.

senses.definition: a person who trains people in sport or another skill, or a long-distance bus
senses.example: The coach helped the team prepare.
senses.note: 长途客车义主要见于英式英语。

senses.definition: to train someone to improve a skill or performance
senses.example: She coaches young swimmers.

senses.definition: a way of doing something, or the money and resources someone has
senses.example: Reading is one means of learning new words.
senses.note: means 作“方法”单复数同形；作“财力”常用复数。

senses.definition: an outdoor area by a building, or a unit of length equal to about 0.91 metres
senses.example: The children played in the yard.

senses.definition: to win against someone, hit repeatedly, or make a repeated sound or movement
senses.example: Our team beat them by two goals.

senses.definition: a regular sound or movement, especially in music or a heartbeat
senses.example: I could hear the beat of the music.

senses.definition: very tired
senses.example: I was beat after the long walk.
senses.note: 形容词义主要见于非正式美式口语。

senses.definition: physical force used to hurt people or damage things
senses.example: The school teaches children to solve conflicts without violence.

senses.definition: including everything or being complete
senses.example: The total cost was higher than expected.

senses.definition: the final amount after adding everything together
senses.example: The total is fifty dollars.

senses.definition: to add numbers together or reach a final amount
senses.example: The bills total more than a hundred dollars.

senses.definition: to be likely to do something, or care for someone or something
senses.example: Children tend to learn from play.

senses.definition: money, time, or effort put into something for a future benefit
senses.example: Education is an investment in the future.

senses.definition: a conversation in which people share ideas about a subject
senses.example: We had a long discussion about the plan.

senses.definition: one of the long parts at the end of your hand
senses.example: She cut her finger while cooking.

senses.zh: 用手指触摸；指认（嫌疑人）
senses.definition: to touch something with your fingers or identify someone as responsible
senses.example: He fingered the fabric to feel its texture.
senses.note: “指认嫌疑人”是非正式美式用法；动词义总体不如名词常见。

senses.definition: an area of land where flowers or vegetables are grown
senses.example: We planted tomatoes in the garden.

senses.definition: to work in a garden, growing plants
senses.example: She gardens every weekend.

senses.definition: to see or become aware of something
senses.example: Did you notice the change in her voice?

senses.definition: a written announcement, or advance warning about a change
senses.example: There was a notice on the door.

senses.definition: a group of things gathered together, or the act of gathering them
senses.example: She has a collection of old photos.

senses.definition: relating to the present or recent times, using new ideas or methods
senses.example: The school has a modern library.

senses.definition: a piece of work that someone needs to do
senses.example: Finishing the report is my first task today.

senses.definition: to give someone a particular job to do
senses.example: The team was tasked with checking the data.

senses.definition: someone you share a relationship, activity, or business with
senses.example: She started the business with a partner.

senses.definition: to work with another person or organization on something
senses.example: The school partnered with a local museum.

senses.definition: hopeful or supportive, certain, or showing that a medical test found something
senses.example: She has a positive attitude toward learning.

senses.definition: a good point or a test result showing that something was found
senses.example: The positives outweigh the negatives.
senses.note: 名词义常用于 positives and negatives。

senses.zh: 公民的；民事的；有礼貌的
senses.definition: relating to ordinary citizens rather than the military, to private law, or to polite behaviour
senses.example: Please keep the discussion civil.

senses.definition: a room where food is prepared and cooked
senses.example: The children helped in the kitchen.

senses.definition: a person who buys or uses goods and services
senses.example: Consumers want clear information about prices.

senses.zh: 射击；尝试；照片；注射；一小杯烈酒
senses.definition: an act of firing, an attempt, a photograph, an injection, or a small drink of strong alcohol
senses.example: She took a shot of the mountain at sunset.
senses.note: shot 也是 shoot 的过去式/过去分词，不应误当成新的动词原形。

senses.definition: a plan for how much money you can spend
senses.example: We need to keep the trip within our budget.

senses.definition: to plan how much money to spend on something
senses.example: They budgeted carefully for the move.

senses.definition: costing less than usual
senses.example: We booked a budget hotel.

senses.definition: to want something to be true or happen, or say you hope something good happens
senses.example: I wish you good luck.

senses.definition: something you want to happen, or a message of good hope
senses.example: Her wish is to travel more.

senses.definition: a picture made with paint, or the act of putting paint on something
senses.example: The painting hangs in the living room.

senses.definition: a person who studies the natural world using scientific methods
senses.example: The scientist studied the lake water.

senses.definition: protected from danger or not likely to cause harm
senses.example: The children are safe at home.

senses.definition: a strong locked box used to keep money or valuable things
senses.example: The documents are in the safe.

senses.definition: a decision or arrangement people accept together, or having the same opinion
senses.example: They reached an agreement on the price.

senses.definition: the part of the face used for eating and speaking, or where a river enters the sea
senses.example: Open your mouth and say ah.

senses.zh: 不出声地做口型；说话不真诚
senses.definition: to form words with your lips, often without making a sound
senses.example: She mouthed thank you from across the room.

senses.definition: a country's main city, money used in business, or an uppercase letter
senses.example: Beijing is the capital of China.

senses.definition: relating to business money, a country's main city, or uppercase letters
senses.example: Write your name in capital letters.

senses.definition: used to connect two negative possibilities or add another negative statement
senses.example: She speaks neither French nor German.

senses.definition: a person harmed by a crime, accident, or bad event
senses.example: The victims of the flood need help.

senses.definition: a regular publication that reports news, on paper or online
senses.example: My father reads the newspaper every morning.

senses.definition: a statement that someone may cause harm, or something likely to cause damage
senses.example: The storm is a threat to coastal towns.

senses.definition: something you must do or take care of, or the duty to answer for your actions
senses.example: It is my responsibility to check the work.

senses.definition: to turn up the corners of your mouth to show happiness or friendliness
senses.example: She smiled when she saw her friend.

senses.definition: an expression on your face made by smiling
senses.example: He greeted us with a smile.

senses.definition: a person trained to give legal advice or act for someone in legal matters
senses.example: She spoke to an attorney before signing.
senses.note: “律师”义尤其常见于美式英语。

senses.definition: points won in a game or test, or written music for a performance
senses.example: The final score was three to one.

senses.definition: to get points or goals, or give points in an assessment
senses.example: She scored two goals in the match.

senses.definition: a record held by a bank or online service, or a report of what happened
senses.example: I opened a new bank account.

senses.definition: to explain something or make up a part of a total, usually with for
senses.example: Transport accounts for a large share of the cost.

senses.definition: holding your attention because it is unusual or enjoyable to think about
senses.example: The book tells an interesting story.

senses.definition: people watching a show, listening to a talk, or reading a piece of work
senses.example: The audience clapped at the end of the play.

senses.definition: having a lot of money, a large amount of something, or a strong taste or colour
senses.example: The soup has a rich flavour.

senses.definition: the main meal of the day, often eaten in the evening
senses.example: We had dinner together at seven.

senses.definition: to show your choice in an election or decision
senses.example: People voted for a new mayor.

senses.definition: a choice made in an election or the act of making it
senses.example: The plan passed by a narrow vote.

senses.definition: in or from the west of a place, or relating to Western countries
senses.example: The city lies in western China.

senses.definition: a film or story set in the old American West
senses.example: He enjoys watching classic westerns.
senses.note: 指欧美文化时常大写 Western；方向义通常小写 western。

senses.definition: to connect things, tell a story, or understand someone's feelings
senses.example: This problem relates to the last lesson.

senses.definition: to go from one place to another or move over a distance
senses.example: She travels to work by train.

senses.definition: the activity of going from one place to another
senses.example: Travel can broaden your view of the world.

senses.definition: a formal discussion in which people give different opinions
senses.example: The students held a debate about school rules.

senses.definition: to discuss different opinions or think carefully before deciding
senses.example: They debated whether to move house.

senses.definition: to stop something from happening
senses.example: Washing hands helps prevent illness.

senses.definition: a person who legally belongs to a country or lives in a town or city
senses.example: She became a citizen of the country last year.

senses.definition: more than half of a group, or the number by which one side wins a vote
senses.example: The majority of students chose the first option.

senses.definition: not one of the people or things mentioned, or no amount of something
senses.example: I offered three choices, but none worked.

senses.definition: the part of something that faces forward, or an area where fighting happens
senses.example: Please wait at the front of the building.

senses.definition: at the forward part of something
senses.example: Use the front door to enter.

senses.definition: to lead a group or appear as its public representative
senses.example: She fronts a local music group.
senses.note: 动词义较口语化或特定行业用语。

senses.definition: brought into life by birth, or having a natural ability or quality
senses.example: She was born in Beijing.
senses.note: born 常与 be 连用，也可表示 bear 的过去分词；“出生”义不是主动生育。

senses.zh: 承认；准许进入；接收入院
senses.definition: to say something is true or allow someone to enter a place or join a group
senses.example: He admitted that he had made a mistake.

senses.definition: older or higher in position or experience
senses.example: She is a senior manager at the bank.

senses.zh: 年长者；高年级学生；资深人员
senses.definition: an older person, a student in the final year, or a person with a higher position
senses.example: He is a senior at the university.

senses.definition: to think something is true without proof, take responsibility, or begin to have a form
senses.example: I assumed the meeting started at nine.

senses.definition: air moving outside, especially strongly
senses.example: The wind blew the leaves across the road.
senses.note: 名词“风”读 /wɪnd/。

senses.zh: 缠绕；蜿蜒；给钟表上发条
senses.definition: to turn or wrap something around, or follow a twisting path
senses.example: The path winds through the forest.
senses.note: 动词“缠绕”读 /waɪnd/；过去式/过去分词 wound /waʊnd/。

senses.definition: an object that opens a lock, a button on a keyboard, or the important part of a solution
senses.example: I left my keys on the table.

senses.definition: very important to a result
senses.example: Trust is a key part of teamwork.

senses.definition: to enter information by using a keyboard
senses.example: Please key in your account number.

senses.definition: relating to a job requiring skill, or done to a high standard
senses.example: She gave us professional advice.

senses.definition: a person trained for a skilled job or paid to do a sport or activity
senses.example: Ask a professional to repair the wiring.

senses.definition: an important task or purpose, or a group sent to carry out such a task
senses.example: The rescue team completed its mission.

senses.definition: moving, happening, or working quickly
senses.example: That train is very fast.

senses.definition: quickly
senses.example: She runs fast.

senses.definition: to avoid eating food for a period of time
senses.example: They fast during the day for religious reasons.

senses.definition: a period of time when someone does not eat
senses.example: He ended his fast in the evening.

senses.definition: without other people nearby or with you
senses.example: She was alone in the room.

senses.definition: without anyone else, or only
senses.example: He travelled alone for a month.

senses.definition: a person or organization that buys goods or services
senses.example: The shop serves hundreds of customers each day.
